title: O God, Whose Will Is Life and Good

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: O God, whose will is life and good
All those who strive with death.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Make strong their hands and hearts and wills
To strive against the body's ills

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: By healing of the sick and blind,
Make known the great physician's mind,

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: Before them set Your gracious will,
That they, with heart and soul,
To You may consecrate their skill
